picker_description: You have access to several companies. Pick one to continue.
picker_empty_description: You have not been added to any company. Ask your accountant for an invitation.
home_description: You are signed in to this company as {{role}}.
gate_not_member_title: You have no access to this company
gate_not_member_description: You are not a user of this company, or it does not exist.
gate_error_description: Something went wrong while checking your access. Try again.
accept_sign_out: Sign out and use the right account
accept_wrong_account: You are signed in as {{current}}. The invitation was sent to {{email}}.
accept_not_found_description: The link is invalid or can no longer be used.
accept_status_expired: The invitation has expired. Ask your accountant for a new one.
history_description: Your new accounting office sees your documents from before the engagement only with your consent. You can revoke it at any time.
history_form_hint: Leave the dates empty to share every document from before your current office.
history_consent_label: I have read and accept the explicit consent text.
history_range_invalid: The end date cannot be before the start date.
history_empty: You have not shared any past data yet.
history_revoke_description: This withdraws your explicit consent: your accounting office can no longer see your documents from before the engagement. You can share them again later.
payroll_description: Payroll printouts and payslips your accountant prepared. Read only.
payroll_error: Payroll documents could not be loaded.
payroll_empty: Payroll PDFs your accountant shares appear here.
payroll_download_failed: The document could not be downloaded.
home_invoices: Your sales and purchase invoices with VAT summaries.
home_receipts: Receipts you sent and their review status.
home_uploads: Send e-invoice XML / ZIP files to your accountant.
load_error: Could not load the data. Try again.
upload_description: Choose an e-invoice XML or ZIP downloaded from your integrator portal. Your accounting office processes the file.
upload_no_office: Your company has no active accounting office, so nobody can process the file.
upload_unsupported: Only XML, ZIP or base64 files can be uploaded.
upload_failed: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.
uploads_empty: You have not uploaded anything yet.
upload_error_PARTY_MISMATCH: Invoice does not belong to this company
home_nothing_missing: Hello {{name}}. Nothing is missing right now.
home_requests_empty: When your accountant asks for a document, it shows up here.
drop_title: Drop a receipt, invoice or statement here
drop_hint: JPG, PNG, WEBP · XML (UBL), ZIP. Photos are read as receipts. Use the app to take a photo.
drop_pdf_to_request: {{name}}: attach the PDF with the request's "Choose file" button.
drop_pdf_no_request: {{name}}: a PDF can only be attached to one of your accountant's requests.
drop_unsupported: {{name}}: this file type is not supported.
recent_empty: You have not sent anything yet.
requests_description: Documents your accountant needs from you. Attach the file to its request.
receipt_fix_hint: Write the correct value of the misread fields; empty ones stay as they are. Your suggestion goes to your accountant and is applied once they approve.
receipt_fix_sent: Your suggestion was sent to your accountant.
receipt_fix_not_allowed: A fix cannot be suggested for this receipt (unreadable or duplicate).
archive_description: Documents your accountant shared with you from their archive (contracts, tax, social security, OHS papers). Read only.
archive_empty: Documents your accountant shares with you appear here.
archive_download_failed: The document could not be downloaded.
important_description: Documents your accountant keeps for you, such as the tax certificate, signature circular and trade registry gazette. Expiring ones are highlighted; send the new one to your accountant.
vat_hint: A live estimate from your sales and purchase invoices. Your accountant sets the final amount with the return.
vat_error: VAT status could not be loaded. Try again shortly.
sales_hint: From the sales invoices you issued; returns deducted, amounts excluding VAT.
foreign_description: Send the invoices of services bought from abroad (Google Ads, Meta, AWS, foreign software licences) here. Your accountant declares the VAT on them (KDV2) for you; a missing invoice means a missing declaration. Upload a photo or PDF; the office checks the rest.
foreign_sent: Your invoice was sent to your office; the office will check and process it.
foreign_sent_again: You sent this file before; no new record was opened.
foreign_unsupported: Only photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) or PDF files up to 20 MB can be sent.
foreign_too_large: The file is larger than 20 MB. Choose a smaller photo or PDF.
foreign_off: Your office turned foreign invoice sending off. Send the invoice to your office another way.
foreign_empty: You have not sent a foreign invoice this month yet.
